summary:
Root accepted actual coordinated whole-instruction loads for programme, canonical board-driver with normal/best wrappers, recovery and progress at 2026-10-18 07:37:29.371499 UTC. PR4669 delivered the independently reviewed consumer source at 248d40d7ab1a516fc6bafaaa61b59837783f5797; all 55 checks passed with four configured skips and identical reviewed/tested/delivered trees. Fresh static custody matched all 82 installed payload members, active entry, adapter and final binding without a runtime invocation. The six shared-checkout user reporting files remain unchanged; their intended changes were reconciled in the isolated source.

Root decided operational programme cutover at 2026-10-18 07:42:17.703507 UTC, effective only when that decision reaches the protected default branch in the canonical owning plan through reviewed ordinary delivery and required checks. At that delivery Project 3 becomes current planning and lane selection for the current Codex programme cohort, and duplicate manual v3 current-status upkeep retires. Strategic scope, owning-plan links and the immutable previous table remain. The owning plan joins accepted final enrollment, installed composition, migration, positive and same-PR continuation, PR4665 ordinary delivery, genuine blocked-case, Observation 17 writes/3 fresh no-ops/20 Verified and scoped user supporting-view evidence. Source/API and user UI evidence retain distinct original cutoffs.

This records a selected effective-on-delivery decision, not a claim that its candidate has already landed. Claude mirrors establish source parity rather than execution or fleet adoption. Games/product contracts remain separate. Every subsequent effect still requires fresh source/body/owner, native capability, intake, conflict and resource admission; Observation Verified is read health, not readiness. No new native SC2 action, replay, automatic human-field update or blanket authority follows. All 439 inherited Unknown reservations, forty-six earlier originals and later distinct originals remain retained without release. Original partial operations, unavailable raw response preimages and hard-containment/escaped-descendant proof gaps remain explicit in original restricted custody; private enrollment and raw evidence stay outside Atlas.
title: Operational V2 programme cutover accepted effective on protected delivery
